newsitem.title: CHINA: China buys wind-powered generators from Denmark.
newsitem.headline: China buys wind-powered generators from Denmark.

text.p: China has purchased wind-powered generators with combined generating capacity of 73 megawatts from Denmark, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.

China Nam Kwong National Import and Export Corp signed a contract in Beijing on Tuesday to purchase an unspecified number of wind-powered generators from Danish companies Micon and Vestas, Xinhua said.
The generators would be installed in the eastern coastal province of Zhejiang, the northwestern region of Xinjiang and in Inner Mongolia in the north, it said.
The purchase was part of a plan by the Ministry of Power Industry to increase wind-powered generating facilities by 120 megawatts at a cost of 1.2 billion yuan ($144.6 million), Xinhua said.
